en: Hand‑colored vintage street scene showing an elegant European spa town. Multi‑story historic buildings line a square with trees and a lamppost. A horse‑drawn tram or carriage full of passengers moves through the street. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand nearby. The caption at the bottom identifies the view as 'Karlsbad. Neue Wiese.' The publisher's imprint and the phrase 'Handkolorirte Künstlerkarte' appear in red at the lower edge.
